newsitem.title: USA: Criticare has high hopes for MPT monitor.
newsitem.headline: Criticare has high hopes for MPT monitor.

text.p: Criticare Systems Inc said Friday it expects the Multiple Parameter Telemetry (MPT) monitor, which received marketing approval from the Food and Drug Administration on December 10, to become its flagship product.
The device is now in beta site evaluation.

"In conjunction with FDA approval of the MPT remote monitoring product, the company is taking steps to further develop the technology as it relates to other patient-related hospital functions," said president Gerhard Von der Ruhr.
The executive said a February 3 private placement of $2.5 million in convertible debentures will fund the accelerated development of the MPT technology.

Criticare also signed a supply and distribution agreement on January 7 with IVAC Medical Systems, a subsidiary of Advanced Medical Inc AMA.N for sales of select vital signs monitors in the U.S. and Canadian hospital markets.

Criticare on Friday posted a loss for the December 31 second quarter of $0.04 a share compared to a year-earlier loss of $0.35 a share, which included a $0.37 a share charge related to its 1995 investment in Immtech International Inc.
The company manufactures monitors and non-invasive sensors.
